name: How long does a typical home remodel project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home remodel project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home remodel project varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small bathroom renovation might take a few weeks, while a whole-house remodel could span several months. We provide a detailed timeline after the initial consultation and design phase.
